question:

(CGL MAINS 2018)

\(\Delta\)BOC मे,

⇒ \(∠BPC = 90° + {∠BOC\over2}\)

 ⇒ 148° = 90° + \(∠BOC\over2\)

फिर,

question:
A circle is inscribed in △PQR touching the sides QR, PR, and PQ at the points S, U, and T, respectively. PQ = (QR + 5) cm, PQ = (PR + 2) cm. If the perimeter of △PQR is 32 cm, then PR is equal to:

(CGL MAINS 2020)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e 11 cm.

Let, PQ = x

QR = x – 5

PR = x - 2

According to the question,

⇒ PQ + QR + RP = 32

⇒ x + x - 5 + x - 2 = 32

⇒ 3x = 39

⇒ x = 13

PR = 13 – 2 = 11 cm
question_hi:

(CGL MAINS 2020)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 11 सेमी है।

मान लीजिए, PQ = x

QR = x – 5

PR = x - 2

प्रश्ननुसार,

⇒ PQ + QR + RP = 32

⇒ x + x - 5 + x - 2 = 32

⇒ 3x = 39

⇒ x = 13

PR = 13 – 2 = 11 सेमी

question:
A triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with center O. AO is produced to meet the circle at K and AO is the angle bisector of A. AD⊥BC. If ∠B = 80° and ∠C = 64°, then the measure of ∠DAK is:

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 8°.

∠DAK = \(\frac{∠B-∠C}{2}\) 

∠DAK = \(\frac{80°-64°}{2} = 8°\)

Alternatively: -

∠BAD = 180° - 90° - 80° = 10°
∠DAC = 180° - 90° - 64° = 26°

∠DAK = \(\frac{∠DCA - ∠BAD}{2}\)

∠DAK =\(\frac{26° - 10°}{2} = 8°\)
question_hi:

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 8° है।

 

∠DAK = \(\frac{∠B-∠C}{2}\) 

∠DAK = \(\frac{80°-64°}{2} = 8°\)

वैकल्पिक रूप से:-

∠BAD = 180° - 90° - 80° = 10°
∠DAC = 180° - 90° - 64° = 26°

∠DAK = \(\frac{∠DCA - ∠BAD}{2}\)

∠DAK =\(\frac{26° - 10°}{2} = 8°\)

question:
△ABC is inscribed in a circle with center O, such that ∠ACB = 115°. O is joined to A. What is the measure of ∠OAB?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 25°.

∠ACB = 115°

(The angle subtended by an arc at the center is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the circumference of a circle)

External ∠AOB = 2∠ACB

External ∠AOB = 115° × 2 = 230°

Internal ∠AOB = 360° - 230° = 130°

In △ABO, AO = BO = radius of the circle

⇒ ∠BAO = ∠ABO

In △ABO

⇒ ∠BAO + ∠AOB + ∠OBA = 180°

⇒ 2∠BAO + 130 = 180

⇒ ∠BAO = \(1\over2\) × (180° - 130°) = 25°
question_hi:
△ABC को केंद्र O वाले एक वृत्त में इस प्रकार अंकित किया गया है कि ∠ACB = 115° है। O को A से जोड़ा गया है। ∠OAB का माप क्या है?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 25° है। 

∠ACB = 115°

(एक चाप द्वारा केंद्र पर बनाया गया कोण, वृत्त की परिधि पर किसी भी बिंदु पर बनाए गए कोण का दोगुना होता है)

बाह्य ∠AOB = 2∠ACB

बाह्य ∠AOB = 115° × 2 = 230°

आंतरिक ∠AOB = 360° - 230° = 130°

△ABO में, AO = BO = वृत्त की त्रिज्या

⇒ ∠BAO = ∠ABO

△ABO में

⇒ ∠BAO + ∠AOB + ∠OBA = 180°

⇒ 2∠BAO + 130 = 180

⇒ ∠BAO = \(1\over2\) × (180° - 130°) = 25°

question:
An equilateral triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with center O.D is a point on the minor arc BC and ∠CBD = 40°. Find the measure of ∠BCD.

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 20°.

∴ ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral

∴ ABCD एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज है

∴ ∠B + ∠ C = 180° (विपरीत कोणों का योग)

question:
An isosceles △MNP is inscribed in a circle. If MN = MP = \(16\sqrt5\) cm, and NP = 32 cm, what is the radius (in cm) of the circle?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 20.

Radius(R) = \(abc \over 4A\) 

Here, A = Area, and a, b, c are the sides

Height = 32

(In an isosceles Δ median drawn to 3rd side is perpendicular)

⇒ \(R = \frac{16\sqrt5\times 16\sqrt5 \times 32}{4\times \frac{1}{2}\times 32 \times 32}\)

⇒ \(R = \frac{16\times 16 \times 32\times5}{2\times \times 32 \times 32}\)

⇒ R = 4 × 5 = 20 cm

solution_hi:

त्रिज्या(R) = \(abc \over 4A\) 

यहाँ, A = क्षेत्रफल, तथा a, b, c भुजाएँ हैं

​
ऊंचाई = 32

(समद्विबाहु Δ में तीसरी भुजा पर खींची गई माध्यिका लंबवत होती है)

⇒ \(R = \frac{16\sqrt5\times 16\sqrt5 \times 32}{4\times \frac{1}{2}\times 32 \times 32}\)

⇒ \(R = \frac{16\times 16 \times 32\times5}{2\times \times 32 \times 32}\)

⇒ R = 4 × 5 = 20 सेमी

question:
